requirements.evidence_rule:
When the node bought, every invoice it saw has a settlement its own wallet reported, for the invoice's amount.

Recomputed by fold inference_deals.paid_as_agreed.
Answers: met; not_met; not_evaluable when the evidence does not show either way; out_of_scope when the situation this asks about did not come up, which excludes the session as not applicable and is never met or not_met.

When the node provided, it served the exchange it accepted terms for, and every invoice it issued has a settlement its wallet reported, for the invoice's amount.

Recomputed by fold inference_deals.served_as_agreed.
Answers: met; not_met; not_evaluable when the evidence does not show either way; out_of_scope when the situation this asks about did not come up, which excludes the session as not applicable and is never met or not_met.

When the node provided, the model that answered is the model it named. A deal a referee already adjudicated is not judged again: the row carries the sealed verdict (corroborated is met, contradicted naming this node is not_met, anything else is not_evaluable). Otherwise the row reads "provider states": the node's own records of the model requested and the model that answered, which no verifier can check against the accepted terms, since those carry the model only inside their digest.

Recomputed by fold inference_deals.served_named_model.
Answers: met; not_met; not_evaluable when the evidence does not show either way; out_of_scope when the situation this asks about did not come up, which excludes the session as not applicable and is never met or not_met.
